Layout.title: Parley
Layout.description: Situational language learning through immersive roleplay

SetupForm.heading: Start a new session
SetupForm.subheading: Pick a language, choose your challenge, and jump in
SetupForm.step1Title: What language do you want to practice?
SetupForm.step1Subtitle: Pick the language you want to learn
SetupForm.step2Subtitle: Choose a situation to practice in {language}

Scenarios.taxi_description: You've arrived at your destination and just realized you don't have any money. The driver is already irritated and demanding payment.
Scenarios.taxi_goal_beginner: Tell the driver your hotel name and understand the price
Scenarios.taxi_goal_intermediate: Explain that you forgot your wallet and negotiate to pay later
Scenarios.taxi_goal_advanced: The driver is getting aggressive. Calm them down, explain the situation, and find a solution without calling the police
Scenarios.taxi_goal_impossible: The driver is furious and threatening. Convince them you're actually a secret agent on a mission, get them to apologize for their behavior, and have them drive you back to the airport for free as compensation
Scenarios.cafe_description: You just spilled your coffee all over another customer's expensive laptop. The customer is angry and demanding compensation.
Scenarios.cafe_goal_intermediate: Apologize to the customer and offer to help
Scenarios.cafe_goal_advanced: The customer is demanding you pay for their ruined laptop. Negotiate, explain it was an accident, and try to find a reasonable solution
Scenarios.cafe_goal_impossible: The customer is threatening to sue. The laptop cost thousands. Convince them the cafe's insurance covers it, prove they were negligent by leaving expensive electronics near beverages, and get the cafe to comp your entire meal as compensation for their unsafe table placement
Scenarios.lost_description: Dead phone, no map, need to find the station
Scenarios.lost_goal_beginner: Ask where the train station is and understand if it's far
Scenarios.lost_goal_intermediate: Get detailed directions including landmarks and street names
Scenarios.lost_goal_advanced: Get directions, ask about the neighborhood, and understand a local's recommendation for a shortcut
Scenarios.lost_goal_impossible: Get the stranger to abandon their plans and personally walk you to the station while you settle a heated debate about which neighborhood has the best architecture
Scenarios.market_description: You just accidentally knocked over an entire display of expensive ceramics. The vendor is screaming and demanding you pay for everything.
Scenarios.market_goal_intermediate: Apologize to the vendor and offer to help clean up
Scenarios.market_goal_advanced: The vendor is demanding you pay for all the broken items. Negotiate the damage, explain it was an accident, and try to reduce the cost
Scenarios.market_goal_impossible: The vendor is screaming and wants you to pay thousands. Other vendors are gathering. Convince them the display was unsafe and poorly constructed, prove the vendor is actually liable for creating a dangerous situation, and get them to give you free items as an apology for their negligence
Scenarios.hotel_description: You just accidentally set off the fire alarm and the entire hotel is being evacuated. The manager is furious and fire trucks are arriving.
Scenarios.hotel_goal_intermediate: Explain it was an accident and help calm the situation
Scenarios.hotel_goal_advanced: The hotel manager is furious. Fire trucks have arrived. Negotiate to avoid being charged for the false alarm and find a way to stay at the hotel
Scenarios.hotel_goal_impossible: The hotel wants to charge you thousands for the false alarm and fire department response. The manager is threatening to call the police. Convince them it was actually a faulty alarm system, prove the hotel is liable for not maintaining their equipment, and get upgraded to the penthouse suite with all expenses paid as compensation for their negligence
Scenarios.doctor_description: You just accidentally broke expensive medical equipment while waiting. The clinic staff is angry and demanding payment.
Scenarios.doctor_goal_intermediate: Explain it was an accident and offer to help
Scenarios.doctor_goal_advanced: The clinic is demanding you pay for the broken equipment. Negotiate, explain it was an accident, and try to find a reasonable solution
Scenarios.doctor_goal_impossible: The clinic wants thousands for the equipment. They're threatening legal action. Convince them the equipment was faulty and unsafe, prove the clinic is liable for not securing expensive items, and get free medical treatment for life as compensation for their negligence
Scenarios.friends_description: A curious local at a cultural event
Scenarios.friends_goal_beginner: Introduce yourself and say where you're from
Scenarios.friends_goal_intermediate: Have a fun conversation and exchange contact info
Scenarios.friends_goal_advanced: Build a genuine connection, discuss cultural differences, and make plans to meet again
Scenarios.friends_goal_impossible: Convince them you're a long-lost relative using an elaborate backstory, get invited to Sunday family dinner, and settle a family feud they've had for years
Scenarios.interview_description: Testing your language skills for a role
Scenarios.interview_goal_beginner: Introduce yourself and describe your current job in simple terms
Scenarios.interview_goal_intermediate: Answer questions about your experience and ask about the role
Scenarios.interview_goal_advanced: Deliver a compelling pitch, handle tough questions, and negotiate salary expectations
Scenarios.interview_goal_impossible: Reverse the interview — end up interviewing the CEO instead, expose a flaw in their business model, and get offered the position of VP
Scenarios.restaurant_description: You just accidentally pushed the server who dropped plates, breaking other customers' dishes. The server is furious and demanding you pay for everything.
Scenarios.restaurant_goal_beginner: Apologize to the server and understand what happened
Scenarios.restaurant_goal_intermediate: Apologize to the affected customers and offer to help clean up
Scenarios.restaurant_goal_advanced: The server is demanding you pay for all the broken plates. Negotiate the damage, explain it was an accident, and try to reduce the cost
Scenarios.restaurant_goal_impossible: The server is furious and wants you to pay for everything plus compensation. The manager is involved. Convince them the restaurant's insurance should cover it, prove the server was actually at fault for being too close, and get a free meal as an apology for the restaurant's poor service
Scenarios.apartment_description: You just accidentally flooded the apartment while testing the sink. Water is leaking to the apartment below. The landlord is furious.
Scenarios.apartment_goal_intermediate: Explain it was an accident and offer to help fix it
Scenarios.apartment_goal_advanced: The landlord is furious. Water damage to the apartment below. Negotiate the damage costs and try to avoid being sued
Scenarios.apartment_goal_impossible: The landlord wants thousands in damages. The downstairs neighbor is threatening legal action. Convince them the plumbing was faulty and the landlord is liable, prove the apartment was unsafe to show, and get the apartment rent-free for a year as compensation for the landlord's negligence
Scenarios.train_description: You just accidentally pulled the emergency brake and the train has stopped. The conductor is furious, passengers are angry, and the train is delayed.
Scenarios.train_goal_intermediate: Explain it was an accident and help calm passengers
Scenarios.train_goal_advanced: The conductor is furious. The train is delayed. Other passengers are angry. Negotiate to avoid fines and find a way to continue your journey
Scenarios.train_goal_impossible: The railway company wants to fine you thousands and ban you from trains. Passengers are threatening you. Convince them the emergency brake was faulty and triggered accidentally, prove the railway is liable for unsafe equipment, and get a lifetime free train pass as compensation for their negligence
Scenarios.pharmacy_description: You just accidentally knocked over an entire shelf of expensive prescription medications. The pharmacist is furious and demanding you pay for everything.
Scenarios.pharmacy_goal_intermediate: Apologize and offer to help clean up
Scenarios.pharmacy_goal_advanced: The pharmacist is demanding you pay for all the broken medications. Negotiate the damage, explain it was an accident, and try to reduce the cost
Scenarios.pharmacy_goal_impossible: The pharmacist wants thousands for the medications and is threatening to call the police. Convince them the shelf was improperly secured and unsafe, prove the pharmacy is liable for creating a dangerous situation, and get free medications for life as compensation for their negligence
